serve_trace_viewer: run a live trace viewer HTTP server that auto-regenerates when trace artifacts change
detect_multi_run: detect whether an output directory contains multiple run subdirectories or a single run
fingerprint_artifacts: compute a SHA-1 fingerprint of trace and result files to detect changes for live refresh
regenerate_viewer_loop: run a background loop that regenerates the trace viewer HTML when artifacts change
serve_dual_stack: start an HTTP server listening on both IPv4 and IPv6 for the trace viewer
